name: GWC Global Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Contested on the promotion's first broadcast as a round-robin, won by Crossbones at Quake of Fire and defended in a steel cage at Extreme Challenge I.

name: GWC Trans-Continental Championship
epitaph: Won by Hypnosis in a ladder match at Quake of Fire and defended by Brian Taylor against Jeff Floyd at Extreme Challenge I.

name: GWC Global Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Its inaugural champions, Inclement Weather, were crowned at Extreme Challenge I.

name: GWC Junior Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Its inaugural champion, Joey Terrell, was crowned in a three-way match at Extreme Challenge I.
